description: Retrieves a user availability schedule by its UUID, including its availability rules and whether it is the user's default schedule.

inputSchema.description: Request to retrieve a user availability schedule.

uuid.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the availability schedule.
uuid.title: Uuid

inputSchema.title: GetUserAvailabilityScheduleRequest

name: get_user_availability_schedule

AvailabilityInterval.description: Time interval during which the user is available.

from.description: Start time of the availability interval in 24-hour HH:MM format (e.g., '08:30').
from.title: From

to.description: End time of the availability interval in 24-hour HH:MM format (e.g., '17:00').
to.title: To

AvailabilityInterval.title: AvailabilityInterval

AvailabilityRule.description: Availability rule defining when the user is available.

date.description: Specific date for the rule in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2022-12-31'). Present when type is 'date'.
date.title: Date

intervals.description: Array of time intervals during which the user is available.
intervals.title: Intervals

type.description: Type of availability rule, typically 'wday' for weekday-based rules or 'date' for specific date rules.
type.title: Type

wday.description: Day of the week for the rule (e.g., 'monday', 'tuesday', 'sunday'). Present when type is 'wday'.
wday.title: Wday

AvailabilityRule.title: AvailabilityRule

GetUserAvailabilityScheduleResponse.description: Contains the details of the retrieved user availability schedule.
GetUserAvailabilityScheduleResponse.title: GetUserAvailabilityScheduleResponse

UserAvailabilityScheduleResource.description: The user availability schedule resource object.

default.description: Indicates whether this is the default availability schedule for the user.
default.title: Default

name.description: Human-readable name for the availability schedule (e.g., 'Working Hours').
name.title: Name

rules.description: Array of availability rules defining when the user is available.
rules.title: Rules

timezone.description: Timezone in which the availability schedule is defined (e.g., 'America/New_York').
timezone.title: Timezone

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the user availability schedule.
uri.title: Uri

user.description: The URI of the user who owns this availability schedule.
user.title: User

UserAvailabilityScheduleResource.title: UserAvailabilityScheduleResource
